title: Aberrant Three-Faced Puppet - Location, Tactics & Rewards
description: Aberrant Three-Faced Puppet in Phantom Blade Zero - where the fight happens, what it drops, and how its attack patterns are countered, including the red and blue flash tells.
keyword: Aberrant Three-Faced Puppet phantom blade zero boss

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Aberrant Three-Faced Puppet is an optional encounter in Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley, found at Challenge Rift.

sections.title: Where to Find the Aberrant Three-Faced Puppet
sections.content:
Location: Challenge Rift.

Appears in: Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley.

sections.title: Weaknesses and Counters
sections.content:
There is no weakness table for this fight because there is no damage-type system to fill one in: nothing here resists, absorbs or is immune to anything, and a chart that says otherwise has been inferred from how the boss looks. Read the fight by attack colour instead - red must be dodged, blue must be deflected, purple means it has just parried you and a counter is already coming. The full explanation is on the combat system.

It is optional, which is why it can be left until the Sha-Chi pool and the Phantom Edge roster are deeper.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content: No drop is recorded for this encounter in the sources checked, so none is listed. That is a gap in the record rather than a statement that it drops nothing.

sections.title: How to Beat the Aberrant Three-Faced Puppet
sections.content:
What works

  • An optional Challenge Rift fight - bring upgraded gear rather than attempting it early.
  • Each face changes the attack set, so re-read the silhouette after every phase change.

sections.title: Status
sections.content: No. 6 of 60 in the progression order, in Prologue & Weeping Creek Valley. Before it: Hua, Deadly Betrothed (新娘阿花). After it: The Gold-Masked One. The roster by region is on the boss list, and the fights that can be lost by leaving a region early are on the order page. Location and drops come from the shipped game; patch 1.0302256 is the most recent change to any boss behaviour and it touched only Hua.
